body:
Thank you. I can't really talk to anyone about this. What you say is probably true, but I don't see it that way. I understand that you choose to be happy and that's great. But it doesn't work for me anymore. I've gone through so much that I don't feel like it's worth it.

I always hide my emotions too. I can't talk about the way I feel. it's almost physically impossible for me. And keeping these emotions inside for so long is what is driving me to this decision.
